title: (Who) / (whom), (which) and (that) 关系代词
description: A picture lesson on relative clauses with the relative pronoun omitted or used. Nine pictures show examples of questions and answers using who/whom/which/that and omitted relative pronouns. The lesson introduces the word kitten and written exercises on rewriting sentences, writing questions and answers, and writing new sentences.
answer_note: The listening questions are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (Structure) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215), item 1 is the printed example. Workbook B (Situations) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215). Grammar I (rewrite by omitting relative pronouns) and II (correct and rewrite) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.559-560).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

1. Who served you? / The man standing behind the counter.
2. Who served you? / The woman standing behind the counter.
3. Who is making all that noise? / The men repairing the road.
4. I served him yesterday. / He is the man I served yesterday.
5. I served her yesterday. / She is the woman I served yesterday.
6. I saw them yesterday. / They are the men I saw yesterday.
7. What's this? / This is the book I bought yesterday.
8. What are these? / These are the books I bought yesterday.
9. What's this? / This is the kitten I found in the garden.
lesson.translation:
1. 是谁接待您的？/ 站在柜台后面的那位男士。
2. 是谁接待您的？/ 站在柜台后面的那位女士。
3. 是谁在发出那么大的响声？/ 修路的那些人。
4. 我昨天接待了他。/ 他是我昨天接待的那位男士。
5. 我昨天接待了她。/ 她是我昨天接待的那位女士。
6. 我昨天见到了他们。/ 他们是我昨天见到的那些人。
7. 这是什么？/ 这是我昨天买的那本书。
8. 这些是什么？/ 这些是我昨天买的那些书。
9. 这是什么？/ 这是我在花园里发现的那只小猫。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

questions.prompt: Who served you? (Picture 1)
questions.answer: The man standing behind the counter.

questions.prompt: Who served you? (Picture 2)
questions.answer: The woman standing behind the counter.

questions.prompt: Who is making all that noise? (Picture 3)
questions.answer: The men repairing the road.

questions.prompt: Who is the man you served yesterday? (Picture 4)
questions.answer: He is the man I served yesterday.

questions.prompt: Who is the woman you served yesterday? (Picture 5)
questions.answer: She is the woman I served yesterday.

questions.prompt: Who are the men you saw yesterday? (Picture 6)
questions.answer: They are the men I saw yesterday.

questions.prompt: What's this? (Picture 7)
questions.answer: This is the book I bought yesterday.

questions.prompt: What are these? (Picture 8)
questions.answer: These are the books I bought yesterday.

questions.prompt: What's this? (Picture 9)
questions.answer: This is the kitten I found in the garden.

lesson.title: Written A: Rewrite these sentences
lesson.instruction: 模仿例句把以下每对句子改写成一句话。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句把以下每对句子改写成一句话。
lesson.context: 6 rewrite items forming relative clauses with the pronoun omitted; 3 examples printed on the page.

questions.prompt: She is the woman. I drove her to London.
questions.answer: She is the woman I drove to London.

questions.prompt: That's the film. I saw it.
questions.answer: That's the film I saw.

questions.prompt: That's the man. I spoke to him.
questions.answer: That's the man I spoke to.

questions.prompt: They are the thieves. The police caught them.
questions.answer: They are the thieves the police caught.

questions.prompt: These are the letters. I typed them.
questions.answer: These are the letters I typed.

questions.prompt: These are the people. You asked me about them.
questions.answer: These are the people you asked me about.

lesson.title: Written B: Write questions and answers
lesson.context: 6 question-and-answer items; 1 example printed on the page.

questions.prompt: I saw that man yesterday.
questions.answer: Which man? That man? / Yes, that's the man I saw yesterday.

questions.prompt: I repaired that car yesterday.
questions.answer: Which car? That car? / Yes, that's the car I repaired yesterday.

questions.prompt: I drove that woman to London yesterday.
questions.answer: Which woman? That woman? / Yes, that's the woman I drove to London yesterday.

questions.prompt: I bought that umbrella yesterday.
questions.answer: Which umbrella? That umbrella? / Yes, that's the umbrella I bought yesterday.

questions.prompt: I took that medicine yesterday.
questions.answer: Which medicine? That medicine? / Yes, that's the medicine I took yesterday.

questions.prompt: I invited that man to my house yesterday.
questions.answer: Which man? That man? / Yes, that's the man I invited to my house yesterday.

lesson.title: Written C: Write new sentences
lesson.instruction: 模仿例句改写以下句子。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句改写以下句子。
lesson.context: 6 rewrite items forming relative clauses; 1 example printed on the page.

questions.prompt: This is the village. I wrote to you about it.
questions.answer: That's right. This is the village you wrote to me about.

questions.prompt: He is the person. I have heard about him.
questions.answer: That's right. He is the person you have heard about.

questions.prompt: This is the test. I spoke to you about it.
questions.answer: That's right. This is the test you spoke to me about.

questions.prompt: She is the woman. I read about her.
questions.answer: That's right. She is the woman you read about.

questions.prompt: This is something new. I haven't thought about it.
questions.answer: That's right. This is something new you haven't thought about.

questions.prompt: This is something. I must decide about it.
questions.answer: That's right. This is something you must decide about.

practice.title: Practice A: Structure
practice.instruction: Write answers to these questions using the prompts and omitting the relative pronoun. 用括号中的提示回答以下问题，省略关系代词。
practice.translation: 用括号中的提示回答以下问题，省略关系代词。
practice.context: 8 structure items omitting the relative pronoun; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Who's that man? (I told you about him.)
questions.answer: That's the man I told you about.

questions.prompt: Who's that girl? (I met her yesterday.)
questions.answer: That's the girl I met yesterday.

questions.prompt: Which is this book? (We talked about it.)
questions.answer: This is the book we talked about.

questions.prompt: Who are those people? (We went to London with them.)
questions.answer: Those are the people we went to London with.

questions.prompt: What's this programme? (I often listen to it.)
questions.answer: This is the programme I often listen to.

questions.prompt: What's that chair? (The president sat on it.)
questions.answer: That's the chair the president sat on.

questions.prompt: Which plane is that? (I flew to America in it.)
questions.answer: That's the plane I flew to America in.

questions.prompt: Who are those women? (I spoke to you about them.)
questions.answer: Those are the women I spoke to you about.

practice.title: Practice B: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What exclamations do you make in each beginning 'What ...?' 读这些情况，用 'What ...?' 开头的感叹句回答。
practice.translation: 读这些情况，用 'What ...?' 开头的感叹句回答。

questions.prompt: A friend has an idea. You think it's good. What do you say?
questions.answer: What a good idea!

questions.prompt: Another friend shows you a photograph he/she took. You think it's excellent. What do you say?
questions.answer: What an excellent photograph!

questions.prompt: The photograph is of a girl. You think she's beautiful. What do you say?
questions.answer: What a beautiful girl!

questions.prompt: You and a friend go to the cinema. You think the film was awful. What do you say about the film when you get outside?
questions.answer: What an awful film!

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences by omitting the relative pronouns according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句改写下列句子，省去关系代词。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句改写下列句子，省去关系代词。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.559 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 13 rewrite items omitting the relative pronoun; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: The boy who is on the blue bike is my son.
questions.answer: The boy on the blue bike is my son.

questions.prompt: The man who is opening the bank is Mr. Brown.
questions.answer: The man opening the bank is Mr. Brown.

questions.prompt: The car that is on the right belongs to Mike.
questions.answer: The car on the right belongs to Mike.

questions.prompt: The hat that the nurse is wearing is part of her uniform.
questions.answer: The hat the nurse is wearing is part of her uniform.

questions.prompt: The babies whom you can see are only a few hours old.
questions.answer: The babies you can see are only a few hours old.

questions.prompt: The bus that we are on will take us downtown.
questions.answer: The bus we are on will take us downtown.

questions.prompt: What's the name of the town that you live in?
questions.answer: What's the name of the town you live in?

questions.prompt: He gave her the purse which she had left in the taxi.
questions.answer: He gave her the purse she had left in the taxi.

questions.prompt: The people who were standing there saw the accident.
questions.answer: The people standing there saw the accident.

questions.prompt: The hospital which is around the corner is the one that we are going to.
questions.answer: The hospital around the corner is the one we are going to.

questions.prompt: Is this the coat which you took off?
questions.answer: Is this the coat you took off?

questions.prompt: I'm afraid there is little that I can do for you.
questions.answer: I'm afraid there is little I can do for you.

questions.prompt: The music that is coming from that window is nice.
questions.answer: The music coming from that window is nice.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Correct the sentences and rewrite them according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句改正并重写下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句改正并重写下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.559-560 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 correct-and-rewrite items; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: The building you are looking is the Foreign Language Department Building.
questions.answer: The building you are looking at is the Foreign Language Department Building.

questions.prompt: I want a watch who I can use as a stop-watch.
questions.answer: I want a watch which/that I can use as a stop-watch.

questions.prompt: This writing paper my father gave it to me is very good.
questions.answer: This writing paper my father gave to me is very good.

questions.prompt: She couldn't find her shopping bag which she had put all her books.
questions.answer: She couldn't find her shopping bag which she had put all her books in.

questions.prompt: The pen he was writing with it was very expensive.
questions.answer: The pen he was writing with was very expensive.

questions.prompt: There were some people not liking the idea.
questions.answer: There were some people who/that didn't like the idea.

questions.prompt: This is my brother going to Australia.
questions.answer: This is my brother who/that is going to Australia.

questions.prompt: I don't know the full name of the person I'm writing.
questions.answer: I don't know the full name of the person I'm writing to.

questions.prompt: There's the boy losing his book.
questions.answer: There's the boy who/that lost his book.

questions.prompt: This is the kitten Jane finding in the garden.
questions.answer: This is the kitten Jane found in the garden.
